channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: Bookings to the Balearics rise; fourth most popular destination in Spain as Britons drive foreign market
item.description: According to the data, in 2025 most visitors to Spain were from the UK (19 million) followed by France (12.7 million) and Germany (12 million) - although the Germans have Mallorca pretty much bought up.

item.title: Winter Sundays by the sea: Brunch at Balneario Illetas
item.description: Our Sunday brunch by the sea is designed to help you slow down, savour the moment and make the most of the weekend before it slips away

item.title: Artificial Intelligence predicts that Mallorca capital Palma will be the city with the highest rent increases in Spain in 2026
item.description: The analysis reflects a diverse scenario, with capitals showing significant increases, especially in the Balearics and the interior and north of Spain.

item.title: Loving Them to Death? The Hidden Wellness Traps for Cats at Home
item.description: What I got wrong about cat care — Even with a wellness mindset

item.title: Passenger assaults Ryanair staff following argument over luggage at Palma airport
item.description: The incident occurred on Sunday at the check-in counter when a passenger on a Palma-Madrid flight struck an employee who informed him that his luggage weighed more than the permitted limit.

item.title: Spain brain drain: 28% of young people have left the Balearics to live and work abroad, Mallorca suffers the most
item.description: The labour market in Mallorca is heavily seasonal and dominated by tourism, which tends to keep average wages below the Spanish national average.

item.title: Balearics youth mental health crisis caused by housing and tourist pressure: worst in Spain
item.description: When asked whether they believe they will live better, the same or worse than their parents or guardians, only 34% of young people are confident that their situation will improve, while the rest believe they will live the same, worse, or do not know what to believe.

item.title: The rain in Spain falls...everywhere: estimated four billion euros of damage and PM calls for united climate change plan
item.description: Sánchez has called for a national agreement that will enable a joint and proactive response, from different perspectives, to the new climate reality, as evidenced by the seven storms that have affected Spain in the first 40 days of the year.

item.title: Peter Mandelson told the Bulletin in an exclusive interview in 2003 in Mallorca that “Tony Blair and New Labour created a national appeal, beyond class, beyond geographical boundary, beyond vested interests.”
item.description: "I’m afraid in today´s world, there is no such thing as a free lunch."

item.title: Mallorca weather forecast for Tuesday, February 10: Temperatures on the rise to 22ºC, wet weekend
item.description: On Tuesday highs are expected to rise to 18º-22º
